current_evidence: The planning-application-process page still links a single 'Local List of Documents [1MB]' PDF, which matches the media/35216/Local-List-of-Documents path, and two web searches found no newer local list or consultation. 'January 2025' comes from the document footer Grokbot extracted ('Planning Local List (January 2025)'). The PDF itself returned client_error with and without the query string, so it could not be re-read.

issues.detail: Nutrient Neutrality Statement is listed under Householder, but Grokbot's own trigger text excludes householder development.
issues.evidence: 'Water Quality Nutrient Neutrality Statement- all applications within Lambourn and Solent catchment areas that result in additional overnight accommodation (but not householder)'

issues.detail: 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' is listed under Householder, but its trigger says it applies to non-householder applications only.
issues.evidence: '...finished floor levels for the new building related to at least one-off site fixed ... datum point (this applies to non-householder applications only)'

issues.detail: Biodiversity Net Gain information is placed only under 'Change of use - prior approval'. The quoted trigger says permitted development is exempt from BNG. BNG is not listed under Full planning or Outline, where the statutory 10% requirement applies.
issues.evidence: 'sets a 10% Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) as a minimum requirement in planning except for ... permitted development under the ... GPDO 2015'

issues.detail: Energy Statement is listed under Outline and Reserved matters but not under Full planning, although the trigger names full applications first. Foul Sewage / SuDS is also placed under Change of use prior approval although the trigger covers only full and outline applications.
issues.evidence: '*For the avoidance of doubt 'planning applications' includes full, outline, reserved matters applications and also for technical details consent.'

issues.detail: 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' has the retail impact / town-centre sequential test trigger, which has nothing to do with flood risk.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'Retail impact assessment and sequential test When it's required For major planning applications for main town centre uses...'

issues.detail: Several requirement-to-trigger mappings are wrong. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' has only the fragment 'of the SUDS design.', while the real SuDS trigger (all majors; minors with >100 sq m increase in impermeable area) sits under 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement'. 'Photographs / Photomontages' carries ecologist-competence text. 'Odour / Dust / Vibration' carries the noise-and-vibration text.
issues.evidence: Foul Sewage trigger: 'Surface Water Drainage Strategy (including provision of SuDS) for i) all major applications ... ii) ... (>100sq.m)'

issues.detail: Many triggers are truncated fragments that do not say when the item applies: Planning Statement ('in the Planning Statement.'), Open space ('applications affecting playing fields.'), Street scene ('within the street scene or the wider landscape.'), Sunlight to gardens ('and their amenity space.'), Construction Management Plan ('requirement for 'construction management plan/site management plan'.') and HRA (a heading fragment). The Householder Arboricultural and Ventilation rows run several checklist bullets together, and Nutrient Neutrality includes the 'Optional (not a validation requirement...)' heading.
issues.evidence: HRA trigger: 'sites (SAC, SPA, Ramsar), and Sites of Special Scientific Interest (SSSI) Providing Biodiversity Net Gain information Why it's required'

issues.detail: About 30 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The extracted text shows the list gives these as 'all applications' or majors/minors (e.g. Archaeology, Contamination, Daylight, Lighting, Noise, Affordable Housing 5+ dwellings), so they also apply to Outline and other types but appear only under Full planning. Examples: Affordable Housing Statement, Land contamination, Archaeological assessment.
issues.evidence: Contamination trigger: 'For all applications on or near (adjacent) land, which may potentially be contaminated'

issues.detail: There is no Heritage Statement row for Full planning or other non-LBC types. It appears only under Listed building consent, although the local list (and the LBC rows) treat heritage significance statements as constraint-driven. The source could not be fetched to confirm the exact trigger.
issues.evidence: LBC row: 'Design and Access Statement Statement of Heritage Significance Required, Depending on Relevant Applicable Constraints'

issues.detail: Advertisement consent, s73, Discharge of conditions, NMA, Works to trees, PiP, Demolition in conservation area and Hazardous substances are all marked '(none)'. The extracted text shows the January 2025 list is organised by application type ('...the proposed householder development', '...proposed works to the listed building', '...your prior notification application'), so these sections were probably missed rather than having no local requirements. This could not be confirmed because the PDF was blocked.
issues.evidence: Tab text: 'The following are not validation requirements, but you may choose to include them to support your prior notification application.'
issues.grok_comment: The raw PDF is readable and does have per-type checklists for Advertisement Consent, S73, Discharge of Condition(s), Non-Material Amendment and Works to TPO/Conservation Area trees that the workbook marks '(none)'; but it has no checklist for PiP, Hazardous Substances or Demolition in a conservation area, so those '(none)' entries aren't shown to be wrong.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Adverts, s73, discharge, NMA and tree works are still wrongly (none); PiP, hazardous substances and demolition in a conservation area are withdrawn.

issues.detail: Nearly all 'Submission rules' items are process, privacy or fee text: the privacy policy, redaction of personal data, the 28-day return rule, 'two unsuccessful attempts', the 25% admin fee and the pre-application fee sheet reference. Pre-application advice and Planning Obligations (S106) rows have advisory text as their trigger, not a validation requirement. The Statement of Community Involvement is only 'encouraged'.
issues.evidence: 'An administration fee of 25% of the application fee will be withheld.'

issues.detail: Some 'Policy-driven requirements' items are table-of-contents lines or headings, not requirements.

The confidential-documents paragraph appears twice in Submission rules, once with the page footer 'West Berkshire Council | Planning Local List (January 2025) 10' mixed in. The scale-bar rule appears four times in Drawing standards.

The Local Plan Review 2023-2041 was adopted on 10 June 2025, after the January 2025 local list. Policy references in the list (e.g. to Core Strategy policies) may now be out of date, although no replacement list has been published.
issues.evidence: Planning page: Local Plan Review 'adopted on 10 June 2025'

summary: The workbook link matches the only 'Local List of Documents' on West Berkshire's planning page (January 2025, no newer version found), but the PDF was blocked so its contents were not re-read. Grokbot's own extracts show clear errors: items explicitly excluded for householders are placed under Householder, BNG appears only under prior approval, Energy Statement is missing from Full planning, triggers are mismatched (flood sequential test vs retail), and many other application-type sections are marked '(none)'.
